property_summary: When calling transfer with _tos = [address(0x1), address(0x2)] and v = 0, the reference contract iterates exactly twice (i=0 and i=1) and succeeds, while the buggy contract iterates a third time (i=2) and reverts due to out-of-bounds access on _tos[2].
change_summary: Change the loop variable comparison from < to <= to cause an extra iteration and potential revert on out-of-bounds or different behavior.
